subject: Film & Cinema
title: Parody and Spoof Films
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Parody and Spoof Films.

hook.text: Airplane! took disaster film clichés and turned every single one into a punchline.

buildup.text: Parody films mock specific genres by exaggerating their conventions to absurd extremes.

discovery.text: The Zucker brothers and Mel Brooks proved that loving a genre is the key to mocking it.

twist.text: The Scary Movie franchise mass-produced spoofs until audiences grew tired of the formula.

climax.text: Good parody requires deep knowledge of what it's mocking — lazy parody just quotes scenes.

punchline.text: The best joke is an inside joke everyone gets.

quiz.question: What makes a parody film work well?
options: Deep knowledge and love of the genre being mocked
